name: Icon
description: A wrapper for Phosphor SVGs (Regular weight; Fill only for selected or active states).

props.name: name
props.description: Phosphor name (airplane-takeoff) or a custom registry key (aircraft-a380).

props.name: weight
props.description: Use fill only for the selected or active state.

props.name: label
props.description: When set, the SVG gets role="img" and this aria-label. When null, the SVG gets aria-hidden="true".

props.name: mirror
props.description: auto flips the icon horizontally in right-to-left pages if its name is on the mirror list.

requirements: Decorative by default (aria-hidden). Standalone meaningful icons get label → role="img" + aria-label.
Icons used as the only signal must meet 3:1 contrast.

rtl: mirror="auto" flips direction-of-travel icons (arrow-left/right, caret-left/right, airplane-takeoff/landing/in-flight/tilt, sign-in/out, arrow-u-up-left, list) in RTL. Objects, time, checkmarks and vertical carets never mirror. Full list: foundations/icons.md.
rules: Library: @phosphor-icons/core (checked at v2.1.1), MIT. Do not use Thin, Light, Bold or Duotone weights.
Custom icons use the same 256-unit grid, 16-unit stroke, round caps and joins. The Emirates logo is not an icon.
